FIELDS.NAME: Climate Control Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Climate Control Solutions provides comprehensive heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) services primarily for residential and light commercial clients. Our operations include system installation, routine maintenance, and emergency repair services, delivered by a team of certified and licensed technicians. We pride ourselves on adhering to the highest safety standards and environmental regulations, ensuring that our practices promote efficiency and sustainability. Our preventive maintenance programs are designed to reduce emergency callouts, extend equipment life, and enhance indoor air quality for our customers. We keep a fleet of well-maintained service vehicles equipped with the necessary tools and safety equipment to ensure prompt and reliable service. We do not engage in any manufacturing or substantial refrigeration work that could involve hazardous materials, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety and regulatory requirements.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in ammonia-based or industrial refrigeration systems and confirms that all field technicians are fully certified and licensed for HVAC and refrigerant handling. Furthermore, we have no unresolved OSHA or EPA violations in the past three years, and there have been no major claims related to fire, explosion, or severe injury in the past five years.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, while servicing a residential HVAC unit, a technician accidentally damaged the client's property, resulting in a repair cost of $1,200. The loss was settled and paid in full, with no further issues arising from the incident.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: Secured Storage, Grade: Standard, Label: Fire Resistant
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour on-site security guard services during high-risk operations.
